reason: The core facts check out against the cited source and independent sources. Apple's listing for Shj AI Guide (seller: Sharjah Commerce & Tourism Development Authority), opened on both the US and UAE storefronts, shows version history 1.0 (2 Oct 2019) through 7.0 released 21 Dec 2022 ("Enabled users to use voice with Fatima"), with no later version; languages English, Arabic, German, Russian, Traditional Chinese; description of a 24-hour virtual tour guide answering by voice or text in five languages that helps users "plan, book and explore". The description mentions no AR, map, itinerary builder, or sustainability feature. Independent coverage agrees: Emarat Al Youm (10 Oct 2022) reports the chatbot upgrade and planned WhatsApp phase, and Day of Dubai lists the five languages across WhatsApp, app, website, and Messenger. On "only official app": the App Store developer page (id919402695) lists one app, Shj AI Guide; Google Play searches for "Shj AI Guide", "Sharjah VR", "Sharjah tourism", and "SCTDA" return no app by SCTDA at all, and the older SCTDA "Sharjah VR" (2015) and the Google Play developer page that a stale search snippet attributed to SCTDA all return 404, so no other SCTDA app is currently listed. Two precision caveats: (1) "only official app" is accurate for what is currently listed, not for all time (Sharjah VR existed in 2015 and is now delisted; Shj AI Guide itself no longer appears on Google Play); (2) "no sustainability features" is true of the app, but SCTDA offers sustainability tools elsewhere: the Sustain Sharjah website (sustainability map, curated itineraries) and the October 2024 "Sustainable Tourism AI Assistant" in 40+ languages (Gulf Today, TTN, SCTDA press release), which was demonstrated via Holobox at GITEX and has no app store listing. Note: AppFollow shows "Last update: Sep 30, 2026" with no version or release note, which is a metadata refresh, not a release; Apple's version history remains at 7.0/21 Dec 2022. Web search budget was exhausted near the end, but all conclusions rest on pages actually opened.
corrected_claim: SCTDA's only app currently listed on the App Store, Shj AI Guide (developer page lists no other app, and no SCTDA app appears on Google Play), was last updated on 21 December 2022 (version 7.0, "Enabled users to use voice with Fatima"). Its listing describes a 24-hour virtual tour guide answering by voice or text in five languages (Arabic, English, German, Russian, Chinese) that helps users plan, book, and explore; the listing mentions no AR, map, itinerary builder, or sustainability feature. SCTDA's sustainability tools live outside the app: the Sustain Sharjah website (sustainability map and curated itineraries) and the October 2024 Sustainable Tourism AI Assistant in 40+ languages, which has no app store listing.
